t: You're in Geraldine Mary Harmsworth Park, a public park in Kennington covering nearly six hectares. It's looked after by Southwark council and bounded by Lambeth Road, Kennington Road, St George's Road and Brook Drive. The grounds wrap around the Imperial War Museum London, which sits at the centre. The park is named after Geraldine Mary Harmsworth, born Geraldine Mary Maffett, an Irish matriarch who lived from 1838 to 1925.
